## Feature Description

Clearly and concisely describe the feature you would like added.

## Problem to Solve

Explain the problem or use case this feature would address.

## Proposed Solution

Describe how the feature should work and any specific details about the implementation.

## Impact or Benefits

Explain how this feature will improve the project or benefit users.

## Alternative Solutions

If you’ve considered alternative approaches to solving this problem, describe them here.

## Additional Information

Add any other context, screenshots, or details about the feature request.
